photo_pixel_measurements.note: Measured from the supplied rust photograph's alpha silhouette; used only as pixel ratios and visual scale.

observed: vertical cylindrical pressure body with a shallow dished top head and a shallow dished bottom head
two opposed horizontal side nozzles with four-bolt flanges at about 0.22 m above the mid-height
large forged lifting eye on a saddle pad at the top centre
two circumferential rope-like weld beads near the top and bottom tangents
prominent fillet weld beads around both nozzle-to-shell joints
blue metallic paint with rust patches and scratches
brass automatic drain / sight-glass assembly under the bottom head: knurled collar, vertical oval window, bottom spigot
no feet, brackets or other visible support in the source photograph
inferred: hidden/back-side topology follows the uncalibrated six-view reference: symmetric second nozzle and back-side drain window; no other ports
flange thickness, bolt-hole diameter, bolt circle, bore depth and raised-face profile
the exact automatic-drain internal mechanism, thread forms and whether both oval windows are glazed
the eye-ring top band and saddle-pad profile
all hidden faces, wall thickness, internal separator element and assembly relationships
support/mounting method and floor contact: no support is visible, so stability is not claimed
